info.title: AI WorkMate API
info.summary: Authentication, AI content generation, content history, and administration API.
info.description: The AI WorkMate REST API powers the user workspace and administrator dashboard. Protected operations use a JWT access token in the Authorization header. Successful responses contain success, message, and usually data. Error responses contain success=false and a human-readable message; validation errors also include field-level errors.

post.description: Registers an active user with the user role. Email addresses are normalized to lowercase.

409.description: An account with the email already exists.

post.description: Authenticates an active account and returns an access token, a refresh token, and the safe user profile.
Consumes a valid, current refresh token and returns a new access/refresh token pair. A rotated refresh token cannot be reused.

200.description: A new token pair was issued.

post.description: Invalidates the stored refresh token and increments the user's token version, invalidating the current token set.

200.description: Content types and their dynamic form fields.
Supported tones, languages, social platforms, and form limits.

post.description: Generates content for the authenticated user and stores it in history. An optional Idempotency-Key makes safe retries possible. Reusing the same valid key returns the existing generation with status 200.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A caller-generated retry key containing 8-128 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

example.description: Summarize completed work, current risks, and the plan for next week.

200.description: An existing generation was returned for the idempotency key.

201.description: New content was generated and saved.

409.description: A conflicting generation request is already using the idempotency key.

429.description: The authenticated user reached the daily generation limit.

502.description: The AI provider failed to generate content.
